ruleDefinitions.name: Local Groups Discovery - MacOs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local system groups

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/dscacheutil$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-q.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*group.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/group.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-list.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/groups.*"))))
